meta.coverage: Table 24: Minutes per participant, every activity in the classification, by household spending fifth, main activity of each half-hour · minutes
meta.sourceTitle: Table (24): Minutes spent in a day on an average per participant of age 6 years and above in different 2-digit/1-digit activity code of TUS activity classification where the activity was done as a major activity (considering only the major activity of the time slots) for different UMPCE quintile classes
meta.note: January–December 2024 survey, age 6 and above unless the source header names another universe. Snapshot axis is an annual anchor, not an observation on 1 January. All-activities time is equally allocated across recorded activities within each slot; major-only time assigns the whole slot to its major activity. Source dashes are catalogued as unavailable and never changed to zero. Source revision date beyond this report edition is not supplied.
